newsitem.title: GERMANY: Three die after French bus crashes in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Three die after French bus crashes in Germany.

text.p: Two French schoolchildren and a coach driver were killed and 11 people were injured on Wednesday when their coach overturned in a collision with a stationary lorry on a motorway in eastern Germany, police said.

A police spokesman said the accident happened near the town of Ziesar, about 60 km (40 miles) from Berlin, when the coach carrying around 30 children, hit the lorry, which was parked in an emergency lay-by.
Some of the schoolchildren, who came from a school in Brittany, were seriously injured, the spokesman said.

He said the children, aged between 14 and 16, had been on their way to visit a school in Greifswald in northeastern Germany. The dead man was one of two drivers on the coach. The other, who was driving at the time of the accident, was unhurt.
The accident closed the motorway, which runs between Hanover and Berlin, for more than three hours.
